text:
Evan Brooks: Hey team, first day trouble. Just unboxed the MBP and ran setup but Kandji says 'Device blocked: Activation Lock detected'. It won't enroll. I don't remember adding a personal Apple ID to this device.

Maya Chen: Welcome Evan! That message means the device is still associated with an Apple ID in ABM/DEP. Did you set up an account during OOBE with an Apple ID when the machine booted?

Evan Brooks: I did sign in with my personal Apple ID for a minute to check iCloud, stupid move. I removed my account but the machine still shows Activation Lock during enrollment.

Apple DEP Bot: ABM Lock status: device serial matches ABM record? yes. Lock state: user-associated. Action required: Apple ID removal via ABM or device owner (requires proof of purchase if not the original owner).

Maya Chen: No worries. Two paths: (1) If you still have access to the Apple ID used, sign in at appleid.apple.com and remove the device from your account, then reboot and re-run enrollment. (2) If you don't have access, Devices Team can file an ABM transfer request with Apple; that takes 24-72h and needs a purchase receipt. Which is it?

Evan Brooks: I don't have that Apple ID anymore. Bought this through the recruiter who gave me the device, receipt is in the offer packet. What info do you need?

Maya Chen: Please DM the purchase invoice and the serial number. Don't paste PII here. We'll start the ABM transfer and meanwhile can provision a loaner or enable a temporary dev VM in Codespaces so you can start.

IT Bot: Ticket #RD-ONB-8182 created and assigned to Devices Team. Attachments required: invoice, serial, your full name and hire date. Estimated ABM transfer SLA: 48-72 hours.

Evan Brooks: Sent DM with docs. Appreciate the loaner offer, would love that if possible. I'm happy to wait on the physical machine.

Maya Chen: Got the docs. Initiated ABM transfer request. I also provisioned a loaner MacBook Air for pickup at reception (if you're remote we can ship). Loaner will have Kandji pre-enrolled.

Evan Brooks: Thanks! Quick Q: once ABM clears and device enrolls, do I need to enable FileVault or will Kandji push that?

Maya Chen: Kandji will push the FileVault enablement profile and escrow the key to our MDM. After ABM/DEP enrollment completes and we confirm machine certs, FileVault will be enabled automatically. Don't manually turn on FileVault before MDM escrow.

Evan Brooks: Good call, I won't touch it. Anything I should do about macOS updates? It's on 12.6.5 currently.

Maya Chen: Security patches are fine; major upgrades we schedule. We'll ensure the build matches our CI runners before pushing you to a different minor. For now you're fine. Once ABM finishes we'll enroll and push the VPN & dev tooling.

Apple DEP Bot: ABM request submitted to Apple. Reference RD-ABM-5521. Expected callback: 24-72h.

IT Bot: Loaner provisioning complete. Pickup at reception or shipping label created. Noted in ticket.

Evan Brooks: Picked up loaner, logged in, codespaces working. Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Awesome. Closing loop once ABM transfer completes and original device enrolls. If you need any admin access on the loaner for dev tools, request a short temp-sudo window and we'll grant it. Welcome aboard!
